Having reviewed the arguments and peer responses, I reaffirm my original position. 

The question addresses the common myth that LSD stores itself in the spinal fluid or spine. Options (B), (C), and (D) are all variations of this scientifically debunked misconception. Option (A) is the only scientifically accurate statement among the choices, correctly describing the pharmacokinetics (half-life) of LSD, which dictates how quickly the drug is metabolized and cleared from the body (including cerebrospinal fluid). 

Final answer: A
